sections.heading: Getting started
paragraphs: Dina had a busy week ahead. He checked his schedule and worked with a colleague to agree on a time. Dina said, “What time is it now?” His friend replied, “It is eight thirty.” Dina said, “My appointment is at nine.” His friend replied, “I have thirty minutes left.” Dina said, “Could we meet a little earlier?” His friend replied, “Would ten o'clock work for you?” Dina said, “That time works perfectly.” His friend replied, “I am busy on Monday morning.” Dina said, “Tuesday afternoon is better for me.” They paused for a moment to remember each expression.

sections.heading: A useful exchange
paragraphs: As they continued, they learned to explain what they needed. Dina said, “Let me check my calendar.” His friend replied, “I have another meeting at noon.” Dina said, “The meeting starts in five minutes.” His friend replied, “Please try to be on time.” Dina said, “I am running a little late.” His friend replied, “I will arrive in ten minutes.” Dina said, “Sorry for keeping you waiting.” His friend replied, “No worries, I just got here.” Dina said, “How long will it take?” They paused for a moment to remember each expression.

sections.heading: Making it clearer
paragraphs: They listened, asked questions, and tried the next useful expressions. Dina said, “It should take about an hour.” His friend replied, “The office closes at five.” Dina said, “Can we move the appointment?” His friend replied, “I need to reschedule our meeting.” Dina said, “Is tomorrow still convenient?” His friend replied, “Please confirm the new time.” Dina said, “I added it to my calendar.” His friend replied, “I set a reminder on my phone.” Dina said, “The deadline is next Friday.” They paused for a moment to remember each expression.

sections.heading: Ending well
paragraphs: Before leaving, they finished the conversation warmly. Dina said, “We have two days to finish.” His friend replied, “Let us start without delay.” Dina said, “We can take a break at eleven.” His friend replied, “I will send you the details tonight.” Dina said, “Thank you for being flexible.” His friend replied, “See you at the agreed time.” Dina said, “I look forward to our meeting.” They felt more confident after practising together.
